decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, Phyrexian Devourer and Fling, using Tinker to search for them. The Altar of Dementia is used to fill up the graveyard with the Phyrexian Devourer's power, allowing for a lethal Fling. Defense Grid is used to protect the combo from counterspells, while cards like Tsabo's Web and Impulse help to dig through the deck. The mana base is designed to support the fast pace of the deck, with cards like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors providing additional mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on utilizing the speed and aggression of Goblins to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to get key Goblins onto the battlefield early, combined with powerful support cards like Goblin Warchief and Siege-Gang Commander, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the start. With a mix of creature removal, mana denial with Wasteland and Rishadan Port, and card draw with Goblin Ringleader, this deck is designed to win fast and efficiently.

This deck focuses on using fast, aggressive Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent and deal damage quickly. It includes cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key creatures, and powerful cards like Goblin Piledriver and Goblin Ringleader to strengthen the board presence. The deck also incorporates control elements like Goblin Sharpshooter and Gempalm Incinerator to pick off enemy creatures. The land base supports the aggressive strategy with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through consistent and efficient aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Academy Rector and Wall of Blossoms to search for key enchantments such as Recurring Nightmare and Worship to set up powerful combos. Cabal Therapy helps disrupt opponents' strategies while Pattern of Rebirth serves as a versatile tool for creature recursion. Pernicious Deed provides board control, while mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Fyndhorn Elves help ramp into big plays. The deck aims to efficiently generate value and assemble game-winning combinations through careful sequencing and resource management.

This deck is focused on quickly assembling the combo of Hermit Druid with Phyrexian Devourer and Triskelion to win the game. The deck uses cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent while setting up the combo pieces with cards like Survival of the Fittest. The mana base is optimized to support the combo and includes cards like City of Brass and Gemstone Mine for fixing. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using control elements to manipulate the game in your favor while also utilizing the Survival of the Fittest engine to tutor for key creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to out value and outlast the opponent, ultimately grinding them down to secure victory. By combining resource denial with creature recursion and various ways to protect your own assets, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and come out on top in the long run.

The main focus of this Aggro - Sligh (RDW) deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent by playing low-cost, high-impact spells and creatures. Using cards like Lightning Bolt, Incinerate, and Fireblast, along with aggressive creatures like Jackal Pup and Ball Lightning, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a defense. The inclusion of cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex also helps to provide additional reach and damage potential to close out games.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble a powerful combination of cards that involve sacrificing Phyrexian Devourer to Altar of Dementia in order to mill a large portion of a player's library. This combo can be achieved through the use of Tinker to search for the necessary pieces, while also utilizing cards like Fling to deal massive damage to an opponent using the Devourer's power. Defensive cards like Defense Grid and Tsabo's Web help protect the combo from disruption, while mana acceleration from artifacts and lands allow for a quick execution of the win condition.

The main focus of this premodern 1 vs 1 control-cycling deck is to use cycling cards like Secluded Steppe and Forgotten Cave to draw into key pieces while controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God. The deck aims to establish a board presence by cycling through cards like Eternal Dragon and utilizing cards like Lightning Rift to chip away at opponents' life totals. Burning Wish provides additional flexibility while cards like Astral Slide offer protection and value. Ultimately, this deck excels at controlling the game while steadily building towards victory.

The main focus of this deck is to swarm the board with elves and utilize mana generation to play multiple cards per turn. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures like Elvish Vanguard and Timberwatch Elf, alongside cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Priest of Titania to generate mana efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Tangle Wire and Winter Orb to slow down the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Living Wish and Concordant Crossroads provide versatility and speed in executing the game plan.

This Aggro-Elves deck focuses on quickly deploying small mana-producing creatures like Llanowar Elves and Fyndhorn Elves to ramp into powerful threats like Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte. Survival of the Fittest helps find key creatures, while Armageddon can disrupt opponents' mana bases. The deck also includes utility creatures like Wirewood Symbiote and Thornscape Battlemage to handle specific threats. Gaea's Cradle provides a powerful mana boost, and the deck can combo off with multiple creatures on the board to overwhelm opponents quickly. With a mix of aggression and synergy, this Elves deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to use Enchantress cards to draw cards whenever enchantments are played, allowing the player to set up their combo pieces quickly. The deck focuses on generating mana and card advantage by playing multiple enchantments and utilizing cards like Mirri's Guile and Sterling Grove to control the board. The combo win condition is to use cards like Replenish and Opalescence to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of enchantments and creatures on the board, setting up for a decisive victory.

The deck revolves around using Hermit Druid to fill the graveyard with creatures, then use Survival of the Fittest to find combo pieces like Phyrexian Devourer, Triskelion, and Volrath's Shapeshifter. By utilizing cards like Unearth and Karmic Guide, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and execute a game-winning combo. The deck also includes disruption elements like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond.

This deck focuses on a very aggressive gameplay style, with a heavy emphasis on dealing direct damage to the opponent. The key strategy revolves around quickly deploying small, but efficient creatures such as Mogg Fanatic and Jackal Pup, while also using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to deal direct damage to the opponent. Cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional sources of damage, while Fireblast can be used as a finisher. Overall, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient damage.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Bottomless Pit, while also applying pressure with cards like Hypnotic Specter and Skittering Skirge. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Diabolic Edict and Snuff Out to deal with threats on the board, while also utilizing The Rack and Cursed Scroll to chip away at the opponent's life total. With a land base focused on disruption with Wasteland and utility with Mishra's Factory, this deck aims to dominate the game through resource denial and efficient threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Madness and Threshold mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By discarding cards with Madness to cast them for less mana and filling up the graveyard to enable Threshold, the deck can quickly deploy powerful threats like Arrogant Wurm and Roar of the Wurm. The deck also includes countermagic like Mana Leak and Circular Logic to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply relentless pressure and win the game through efficient creature beats.
